data_notes: Read-only React frontend feature. No new persistent entities, tables, or repositories are introduced. The frontend consumes existing backend endpoints backed by already-defined tables (employees, leave_requests, leave_balances, leave_types, leave_policies) and their existing repositories (PgEmployeeRepository, PgLeaveRequestRepository, PgLeaveBalanceRepository, PgLeaveTypeRepository, PgLeavePolicyRepository — all PostgreSQL via the shared pg Pool). No schema changes, no new repository interfaces/implementations, and no migration work are required for this phase.
transaction_contract: None — this feature is read-only (login is a single non-persistent write; all other endpoints are reads). No multi-step writes requiring atomicity, so no transaction/unit-of-work contract is introduced.
